finding: For arbitrary 4×4 complex A,B (even without tracelessness), write x=σ1(A), y=σ1(B), sA=||A||F²−x², sB=||B||F²−y². Then 2(||A||F²+||B||F²)−[σ1(A⊗I+I⊗B)²+σ2(...)²]≥2(sA+sB−2xy). Indeed the Ky-Fan-two ℓ2 norm is max_{rank P=2}||XP||F and the triangle inequality gives at most √2(x+y), because each Kronecker factor has its largest singular value repeated four times. Consequently the T2-dual bound holds whenever sA+sB≥2xy, with strict margin if the inequality is strict; in particular whenever ||A||F²≥2x² and ||B||F²≥2y², by AM–GM.
scope: A condition in original dual variables, not a proof of full T2. It includes a nonempty open class of pairs with both squares nonnormal: the effective-rank inequalities are strict on tracezero unitaries and persist under small perturbation, while the equation [A²,(A²)†]=0 is a proper real-algebraic condition and hence has empty interior.
